The '''Terrik family''' were a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] lineage considered to be a legendary family of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|cardname=Pulsar Skate}}</ref> The family consisted of [[Booster Terrik]] and his wife, [[Jysella Terrik|Jysella]], and their daughter, [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]]. Terrik also considered [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to be part of his family after the [[Bonestar Pirates]] killed Antilles' parents.<ref name="SV">''[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|Scum and Villainy]]''</ref> The Terrik family was related to the [[Horn family]] through the marriage of Mirax to [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and former [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].<ref name="XW:BW" /> The marriage produced two children, [[Valin Horn|Valin]]<ref name="SotP">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> and [[Jysella Horn|Jysella]].<ref name="DT-I">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide I: Onslaught]]''</ref>
